english: Its wide roads, which can take fourteen lanes of traffic, have been kept away from living areas.
text: keep roads away from living areas 说的是规划时让道路与居住区隔开，不是把已有道路搬走。keep something away from 可表达维持空间隔离；which 中的 take 表容纳，让读者知道被隔开的道路规模很大。
